best_match.fbbt_definition: A spermatid which has initiated axoneme elongation, but which is relatively short (up to 200 micrometers in length) and retains a round nucleus. The two parts of the mitochondrial derivative are roughly equal in size.

justification: The authors annotated this type with FBbt:00057175 'early elongation stage spermatid', a current (non-obsolete) FBbt cell term; FBbt has no adult-specific variant of it. The authors' typing is taken at face value.
recommendation: Map to the authors' term FBbt:00057175 'early elongation stage spermatid', exact match.
